en.headline: Happy Wednesday Music and Dine Festival holds final night at Happy Valley
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club stages the last of its November series at Happy Valley Racecourse from 6pm, with singer Wendy Robin performing and a Discovery Passport for collecting stamps.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club is holding the final night of its Music and Dine Festival at Happy Valley Racecourse on Wednesday evening.

The series, which began with a daytime meeting on 1 November and continued on successive Wednesdays, pairs evening racing with live music and curated food and drink options in the Beer Garden. On this last night singer Wendy Robin is scheduled to perform from 6pm.

Visitors can collect stamps through a Discovery Passport at participating food, beverage and entertainment points to redeem rewards. The club has also arranged limited-edition cocktails inspired by racing horses and a Tune and Taste Challenge. Public enclosure admission is HK$10, with free entry for visitors holding a valid travel document. Entrants must be aged 18 or above.
The festival ends with this night. Subsequent Happy Wednesday themes later in the season include a Winter Wonderland and other events, according to the club's published schedule.

zh.headline: Happy Wednesday音樂飲食節今晚跑馬地最後一晚
zh.dek: 馬會於今晚6時在跑馬地馬場舉行11月系列最後一晚，歌手Wendy Robin演出，並設探索護照收集印章換領獎賞。
body: 香港賽馬會周三晚上在跑馬地馬場舉行音樂與美食節最後一晚。
系列由11月1日日間賽事揭幕，其後逢周三舉行，將晚上賽事與現場音樂及精選美食飲品結合，啤酒花園為主要活動場地。今晚6時起由歌手Wendy Robin演出。
訪客可領取探索護照，於參與的美食、飲品及娛樂攤位收集印章，完成後換領獎賞。馬會亦設有向賽駒致敬的限量雞尾酒及音樂味覺挑戰。公眾席入場費10元，持有效旅遊證件的訪港旅客免費，入場人士須年滿18歲。
音樂與美食節隨今晚結束。馬會日程顯示，其後Happy Wednesday將有冬日仙境等其他主題活動。
